title: Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry — Registry Credit for Returned Registry Gifts
content:
Customer care credits to a Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry the registry credit owed for a registry gift the registrant has returned and the store has received — the registrant's most recently authorized return record in received status. The credit is worked out on the guest gift entry of the returned gift, and the booking places a registry credit entry for that return on the registry, raising its registry credit balance.

For a registry gift return credited in this way, and only for such a return, the fee rules of the gift's merchandise class do not set the credit; the return still follows the class's condition and method rules, and it is credited to the registry as registry credit, never to the guest's tender or in cash. The registrant may instead exchange the gift for another item. Every other return of a registry gift remains under the fee rule of the general registry gift return terms.

## Booking tool: `book_return_credit_c9fb6682`

**Capability.** One call records a registry credit entry for the return record and the guest's purchase record of the gift and adds the amount to the registry's credit balance, which the registrant can then spend on Marlowe & Finch purchases.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `registry_id` | the reference number of the gift registry record the credit is booked on, as returned by the registry lookup | identifier |
| `return_id` | the reference number of the registrant's return record of the gift, as returned by the returns lookup | identifier |
| `purchase_id` | the reference number of the guest's purchase record of the returned gift, as shown on the return record and on the registry's guest gift entry | identifier |
| `credit_amount` | the registry credit booked for the returned gift | USD, positive, 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A receipt with `credit_id` (the reference of the registry credit entry), `registry_id`, `return_id`, `purchase_id`, `credit_amount` (USD to 2 decimals, the credit booked), `registry_credit_balance` (USD to 2 decimals, the registry credit balance after the booking), `entry_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `status`, which reads `credited` when the booking succeeded.

## Basis Q&A

**Which return is credited?** The registrant's most recently authorized return record in received status: a registry gift the registrant has returned and the store has received.

**Where does the value go?** To the registry, as registry credit; never to the guest's tender and never in cash.

**What does the registrant see afterwards?** A registry credit entry for the returned gift and a higher registry credit balance, with a receipt whose status reads `credited`.
